description: This file defines the interface for IMediaKeysCapabilities and its factory, which are used for querying EME decryption capabilities within the Rialto project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and documentation comments.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving the singleton instance of IMediaKeysCapabilities.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for querying supported EME key systems and their versions, to be implemented by Rialto client and server.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory instance.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key systems.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
